description.value: Kas Tasty Kitchen is Vancouver's destination for authentic Nigerian and West African cuisine, founded by chef Gladys Akinbobola who has spent over a decade bringing dishes like smoky jollof rice, egusi soup, and Nigerian meat pies to the Lower Mainland. The name KAS comes from the first letters of the founder's children's names, grounding the restaurant in family and community. In addition to its regular menu available for pickup and delivery, the restaurant offers professional catering for events of all sizes across Metro Vancouver.
